newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Perez Companc raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Perez Companc raised.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming said it had upgraded Argentine energy company Perez Companc SA to long-term buy from hold.

-- The company's first quarter earnings of $74.1 million "were slightly above our $72 million estimate and 9.8 percent higher than they $67.5 million earned a year ago," analysts Jose Costa Buck and Gonzalo Pangaro wrote in a Friday report.
-- However, Perez Companc's earnings "were not as good as they look since they were lifted by a $7.6 million allowances reversal."
-- They noted Perez Companc continued its capital expenditure program, investing more than $302 million in Latin America.
-- "We believe that investors should focus their attention on PERE's sound strategic vision and ambitious capex program rather than on 1Q's lower-than-expected earnings quality."

-- Another attraction was Perez Companc's possible full listing this year on the New York Stock Exchange. "Access to a broader investor base should result in a higher liquidity for the stock and a larger premium over the market," Costa Buck and Pangaro wrote.
